format: BibleWorks VPL (verse-per-line plain text). fraLSG_vpl.zip also contains fraLSG_vpl.sql and fraLSG_vpl.xml; the .txt is extracted and cached here.

audit.bracketWrappedNote: The single bracket-wrapped row is ACT 28:29, a genuine verse present in Segond's text and bracketed by the edition as a textual variant ("[Lorsqu'il eut dit cela, les Juifs s'en allèrent, discutant vivement entre eux.]"). It is NOT the KJV '[]'-at-3-John-1:15 empty-placeholder artifact class, so no stray-row filter is applied.
audit.note: French orthography was observed, not normalized: apostrophes are consistently U+2019 (curly); no U+0027, no guillemets, no NBSP/thin spaces, no HTML entities. Accented characters, the œ/Œ ligature, curly double quotes, ellipsis and en/em dashes appear as real text and are preserved verbatim.

versificationFinding.summary: fraLSG's versification does NOT match the KJV/WEB-based canon.js in several books; this was already flagged in PROJECT_HISTORY.md ('Segond's versification differs materially ... e.g. Psalms +66 verses ... it will need the same reconciliation treatment the OSHB Hebrew import received before it can populate canon.js-shaped data'). The raw source is intact and was not altered; the mismatch is a canon.js reconciliation decision, not an import defect.
bookMismatches: PSA: source 2527 verses vs canon 2461 (+66; Hebrew-style Psalm titles counted as verses, e.g. PSA 3:1 is the superscription)
3JN: source 15 verses vs canon 14 (final greeting split into v14 + v15)
ROM: source 433 vs canon 436 (doxology placement, matches the known-variants Romans entry)
EST: source 167 vs canon 207 (canon provisional, has Greek additions)
DAN: source 357 vs canon 530 (canon provisional, has Greek additions)

eBible fraLSG details page names no versification scheme
phaseA_versificationCheck.idLine: \id GEN GENFLS1910.PTX, Louis Segond 1910, French, 31-10-2011, Moon Sun Kim. Updated for DBL by E. Canales, September 2012.
phaseA_versificationCheck.workedExample: EXO 7 in the USFM itself runs to v29 then \c 8, i.e. the source carries the same shifted chapter boundary as the VPL; there is no dual/alternate numbering to cross-reference.
phaseA_versificationCheck.conclusion: The USFM export provides no authoritative per-verse cross-reference analogous to OSHB's <note>KJV:...> annotations. Phase B must be built from an external scholarly cross-reference rather than derived from this source.
